program.text:
<program>
task: who holds each book after the swaps (A is Alice, B is Bob, C is Claire, D is Dave, E is Eve)
input: the swaps in order, each as the initials of the two people
events: AB AC AD AE BC BD BE CD CE DE
hound_of_the_baskervilles: A B C D E
pearl: A B C D E
ulysses: A B C D E
catch_22: A B C D E
lolita: A B C D E
start: hound_of_the_baskervilles=A pearl=B ulysses=C catch_22=D lolita=E
on AB: each A>B B>A
on AC: each A>C C>A
on AD: each A>D D>A
on AE: each A>E E>A
on BC: each B>C C>B
on BD: each B>D D>B
on BE: each B>E E>B
on CD: each C>D D>C
on CE: each C>E E>C
on DE: each D>E E>D
answer: if hound_of_the_baskervilles=D: Dave has Hound of the Baskervilles (A). if pearl=D: Dave has The Pearl (B). if ulysses=D: Dave has Ulysses (C). if catch_22=D: Dave has Catch-22 (D). else: Dave has Lolita (E).
</program>
